question: In a certain code language, if PERJURY is coded as '108', DECEPTION is coded as '86', then what will 'WITNESS' be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

PERJURY is coded as '108'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/458bee6421ff2b946593dfd8e055b6d79e4627a4e90e30619e42cf58d1dc494c.png] 

And, 

DECEPTION is coded as '86'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42720f78cd5a14ebb1a01a5539d09dee7e94ed7fe9d16ce1719d169db1fa83ed.png] 

Similarly,

'WITNESS' will be coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5f5c4d217e18cbc69c6bb3eae41639f49eb9d6c777fc821d68db22933868516.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
